title: 2024-09-18: Federal Reserve cuts the policy target by half a percentage point
text: The Federal Reserve announced a 0.5 percentage-point reduction in its federal funds target range to 4.75–5.00%. The statement cited progress on inflation and a changed balance of risks to its employment and inflation objectives. This is a historical monetary-policy record; it does not establish a causal effect on Nvidia or Amazon shares.

title: 2024-02-01: Amazon reports fourth-quarter 2023 sales and earnings
text: Amazon reported fourth-quarter 2023 net sales of USD 170.0 billion, up 14% from the prior-year quarter. AWS sales were USD 24.2 billion, up 13%. Group operating income was USD 13.2 billion, compared with USD 2.7 billion a year earlier. These figures describe the reporting period ending December 2023; the release became public in February 2024.

title: 2022-02-25: EU foreign ministers adopt further restrictions following Russia's invasion of Ukraine
